 The main story campaign of GTA 6 on PS5 will take about 50 hours and include 100 missions. 
 Maxim Boldson 
 GAMES 
 November 15, 2026 
 Views: 5119 
 According to recent reports, the average time to complete Grand Theft Auto VI's main story campaign on the PlayStation 5 console will be approximately 50 hours. The final duration will depend directly on the individual player's pace, playstyle, and skill level, so for some players, completing the open-world main story without taking into account side activities may take significantly longer. By comparison, the storyline of the previous numbered installment in the series contained approximately 70 missions and required approximately 35 hours for a standard completion.
 The single-player campaign of Rockstar Games' new project is structured into five full chapters, which together comprise exactly 100 main story missions. The stated running time of 50 hours covers only the central storyline and does not include time spent exploring locations, participating in random world events, or completing secondary missions. The developers' division of the narrative into separate, large chapters is similar to the structure previously implemented in Red Dead Redemption 2.
 To 100% complete the game and earn the Platinum Trophy on PlayStation 5, players will easily need to spend over 200 hours of real-time play. This impressive figure is due to the size of the game's map and the numerous additional challenges that extend far beyond the 100 story missions across the five main chapters. The current-gen release will offer players one of the longest single-player experiences in the franchise's history.
